name: Australian Fossil Mammal Sites (Riversleigh / Naracoorte)
description: Two Australian fossil sites sit far apart: Riversleigh in northwest Queensland and Naracoorte in South Australia's southeast. Riversleigh's rocks hold remains of marsupials spanning some 20 million years. Naracoorte's caves preserved animals over the last 170,000 years, showing how pouched mammals coped with a changing climate. Together they rank among the world's ten greatest fossil sites.
